messages:
Alicia: Heads-up - we saw another 413 spike on /v1/embeddings this morning from a customer sending mixed dims + big arrays. stack traces point at preflight failing then runtime rejecting.
Benji: Ugh. Is this the same tenant from last week?
Alicia: Different tenant. But payload shape looks similar: mixed dims, ~1.2M bytes, 4k vectors. They hit the soft-splitter and then it got routed to slowpath causing backpressure.
Dave: We should add a tiny fastpath hint in the SDK: prefer sending as multiple small requests for >500kB. But we also need a console UX to explain why split happened.
Charu: Agreed on UX. Can we show "split reason" in the request trace and a quick suggested fix (e.g., split into N=4 with dims=768)?
Benji: From runtime side, we can add a telemetry tag: embed.shape_hint = "oversize-mixed" and unit_estimate. That'll let console surface patterns without leaking payload.
Alicia: Example header we could require (opt-in) - helps router choose: 
```
X-Embed-Shape: dims=768,count=4096,bytes=1203456
```
matt.j: Careful with headers; some clients can't set them. Make it optional and fallback to server-side preflight detection.
Benji: Runtime already emits preflight.metric with reason codes: PRE_SIZING, MIXED_DIMS, FRAMING. We can add an incremental counter for "fastpath-suggested" so console can show % that could have avoided slowpath.
Charu: For rollout: show a canary widget in console for top 10 tenants with an actionable "suggest split" button that prepares curl snippets. Also add a chart: pct of requests causing splitter + avg latency delta.
Alicia: What's the quota implication? If we surface suggestions, customers may change behavior and we need to reflect in billing units (embedding units).
Benji: We'll map suggested-splits -> estimated units and show estimated cost delta using existing unit model. console can show "this change would lower cost by ~X%".
Dave: Ops ask: add an alert when splitter-induced queue latency > 200ms for >5m. deploy-bot: New alert rule created: splitter.queue_latency_p95 > 200ms for 5m (owner: eng-platform) :white_check_mark:
Alicia: Timeline? I can prototype the trace annotation and telemetry tag this week. Charu - can you draft console mock for the suggestion card?
Charu: Yep, will drop a quick Figma and sample curl snippets by EOD Thu.
Benji: I'll push the telemetry tag and unit_estimate metric to staging. Need someone to validate it with a synthetic mixed-dim load.
Dave: I can run synthetic load on staging tomorrow afternoon.
Alicia: Cool. We'll coordinate for a small canary then roll if numbers look good. :+1:
